python -c "
import parse

# Test various scenarios with trailing newlines
tests = [
    ('{:d}', '42'),
    ('{:d}', '42\n'),
    ('{:d}\n', '42\n'),
    ('{:d}\n', '42'),
    ('{}', 'hello'),
    ('{}', 'hello\n'),
    ('{}\n', 'hello\n'),
    ('{}\n', 'hello'),
    ('{name:d}', '42'),
    ('{name:d}\n', '42\n'),
    ('{name:d}\n', '42'),
]

for fmt, text in tests:
    result = parse.parse(fmt, text)
    print(f'parse({fmt!r}, {text!r}) = {result}')
"
